Residents and businesses in parts of Accra East and Tema should prepare for scheduled power interruptions between Sunday, November 8, and Friday, November 13, 2026, as the Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) undertakes maintenance works.
The planned exercise will affect different communities on specific days, with outages in Accra East scheduled from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm, while the Tema operations will take place on Tuesday, November 10, and Thursday, November 12, between 10:00 am and 4:00 pm.
